rationaleAppend: Isaiah wave I-4: Isa 22:11 ʿōśêhā 'the one who made it'. The participle is plural in form, with the plural-noun vowel before the suffix, as at Job 35:10 and Ps 149:2. It is rendered in the singular, as in ASV, JPS 1917 and NJPS, and in a verbal phrase to match the parallel yōṣᵉrāh 'the one who formed it' (overlay yotser-potter-clay-image-isaiah). The stable Isa 29:16 'its maker' and 54:5 'your Maker' are unaffected.

Isaiah wave I-4: Isa 22:11 yōṣᵉrāh mērāḥôq 'the one who formed it long ago', 'form' kept. ASV ('purposed') and NJPS ('designed') read the planning sense, as at Isa 37:26 (yᵉṣartîhā), and are reported in commentary.
Isaiah wave I-4: Isa 22:14 heʿāwōn hazzeh 'this iniquity' (ASV, JPS 1917, NJPS), with the Pual of kpr 'be atoned for' (overlay kupar-atonement-isaiah).
Isaiah wave I-4: Isa 22:18 ʾereṣ raḥăḇaṯ yāḏāyim 'a wide land' (literally 'broad on both hands', the idiom of Gen 34:21); base value 'land' (ASV 'a large country'; NJPS 'a broad land').
